historical_variance_calibration.source: latest 20 available prelaunch Edgewalker daily logs
historical_variance_calibration.warning: Historical sessions span prior code/config states and include human intervention; they calibrate variance only and are not confirmation evidence.

rationale: Sixty sessions provide twelve non-overlapping five-session trading-week blocks, the minimum fixed horizon selected for a useful moving-block bootstrap.

The first-stage horizon is intentionally shorter than the 175-session iid approximation so Edgewalker can learn from shadow challengers within one quarter rather than freezing production for most of a year.
A positive 60-session point estimate is not automatically described as statistically strong; the frozen bootstrap lower bound determines that label.

formal_analysis.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of log daily returns
formal_analysis.aspirational_rule: geometric mean daily return at least 0.01 and lower bound above zero
